card.name: Linking words before a stated purpose or use
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, a, is, used, in and commas, right where a sentence explains what something is used for or how it works. Seen in plant, gardening and product-use text.

modes.label: Purpose or use phrase
modes.description: A small word that leads into what an object or plant is used for.
modes.example: you light one candle, plus the shamash, the candle used<< to>> light the others.

modes.label: Plant lists and handling steps
modes.description: Commas inside lists of plant types, or small words in planting instructions.
modes.example: elongated thickened stems called rhizomes as in cannas<<,>> calla lilies, lily-of

modes.label: Product or vial instructions
modes.description: The verb right after a noun like vial that states how it is intended to be used.
modes.example: Each vial<< is>> intended for one-time use only.
